build_CPMHead: build a CPMHead instance with multi-stage deconv layers for heatmap-based pose estimation
forward_CPMHead: run forward pass on multi-stage feature maps to produce a list of output heatmaps
predict_CPMHead: predict keypoint coordinates and scores from multi-stage feature maps with optional flip test TTA
loss_CPMHead: calculate multi-stage keypoint losses and pose accuracy from feature maps and ground truth heatmaps
make_deconv_layers_CPMHead: create deconvolutional layers with configurable output channels and kernel sizes for upsampling
